verses.text: Look, a king will rule by doing what's right, and his officials will govern with justice.
Each will be like a place to hide from the wind and take cover from a storm, like streams running through dry ground, like the shade of a huge rock in an exhausted land.
People who can see won't have their eyes clouded over. People who can hear will pay attention.
People who rush into things will learn to understand. People who stumble over their words will be ready to speak clearly.
Nobody will call a fool noble anymore or treat a crook like somebody worth looking up to.
A fool talks nonsense and plans wrongdoing inside, doing what dishonors God and saying false things about the LORD. They leave hungry people empty and take water away from people who are thirsty.
A crook's ways are evil. They plan to ruin humble people with lies, even when the one in need tells the truth.
But someone noble plans good things and keeps doing them.
Get up, you women taking it easy! Listen to my voice! You daughters who think you've got nothing to worry about, hear what I'm saying!
In a little more than a year, you carefree women will be shaken. The grapes will fail. There won't be a harvest.
Shake, you women taking it easy! Get upset, you who felt so secure. Take your clothes off and wrap sackcloth around your waists.
Beat your breasts for those lovely fields and the vines that used to bear fruit.
Thorns and briers will come up all over my people's land, even over the houses where people used to celebrate in that joyful city.
The palace will be abandoned. The crowded city will empty out. The hill and the watchtower will become dens for good, a playground for wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks,
until the Spirit is poured on us from above, and the wilderness turns into a fruitful field, and the field grows so thick it's counted as a forest.
Then justice will live in the wilderness, and righteousness will stay in the fruitful field.
Doing what's right will bring peace. The result of righteousness will be quiet and confidence that last forever.
My people will live in peaceful homes, in safe places, and in quiet places to rest,
even if hail flattens the forest and the city is leveled.
Blessed are you who plant beside every stream and let your ox and donkey roam free.
